---
title: "分析报告"
format:
  docx:
    reference-doc: reference.docx
    toc: false
params:
  title: "分析报告"
  summary: ""
  scope: ""
  method_text: ""
  result_text: ""
  limitation_text: ""
  figure_path: ""
  figure_caption: ""
  table_caption: ""
  output_text: ""
  references_text: ""
  versions_text: ""
  table_rows:
    value: []
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
required <- c("title", "summary", "scope", "method_text", "result_text", "limitation_text")
if (any(!vapply(required, function(key) is.character(params[[key]]) && nzchar(params[[key]]), logical(1)))) {
  stop("required report slots are missing")
}
if (nzchar(params$figure_path) && !file.exists(params$figure_path)) {
  stop("figure_path must point to a published source figure")
}
rows <- params$table_rows
if (length(rows)) {
  rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rows, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
```

# `r params$title`

## 摘要

`r params$summary`

## 数据范围与分析边界

`r params$scope`

## 材料与方法

`r params$method_text`

## 分析结果与解读

`r params$result_text`

```{r result-table, results='asis'}
if (length(rows)) {
  knitr::kable(rows, booktabs = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n*表 1. %s*\n", params$table_caption))
}
```

## 图件

```{r figure, fig.align='center'}
if (nzchar(params$figure_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(params$figure_path, auto_pdf = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n*图 1. %s*\n", params$figure_caption))
}
```

## 局限、未完成与待验证

`r params$limitation_text`

## 输出文件说明

`r params$output_text`

## 参考文献

`r params$references_text`

## 软件与资源版本

`r params$versions_text`
